title: COAST / GARY barks coast
description: Things Gary says on the coast.

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Lots of people out there miss the good old days."
dialogueTree.polish: „Wiele osób tęskni za starymi dobrymi czasami”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Шмат хто сумуе па старых добрых часах."

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "People are starting to think, waking up."

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Don't you ever wish Hjelmdall was a real place?"
dialogueTree.polish: „Kto nie marzył o tym, aby Hjelmdall było prawdziwym miejscem?”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Няўжо табе ніколі не хацелася, каб Хэймдаль быў сапраўдным месцам?"

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "You think it's gonna be much longer?"

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "People are just scared of the truth."

dialogueTree.speaker: Gary, the Cryptofascist -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "I'm just saying, as a *Revacholian*, I am slightly worried."
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Я проста кажу: як *рэвашолец*, я крыху непакоюся."
